errors.text_span: Die rechte y-Achse für den Saldo reicht von -200 bis 200.
errors.evidence: The figure's right y-axis runs from about -200 to 400, not -200 to 200.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie repräsentiert die Importe und beginnt bei ca. 180, steigt auf ca. 280 und endet bei ca. 340.
errors.evidence: The blue import line starts near 200, rises to about 290, and ends around 345, so the starting and intermediate values are understated.

errors.text_span: Die rote Linie stellt die Exporte dar, beginnend bei ca. 130, steig auf ca. 170 und bleibt dann weitgehend stabil.
errors.evidence: The export line begins near 135, dips sharply below 100 early in 2020, then rises to around 175-180 and only later stabilizes; it does not simply rise from 130 to 170 and stay stable.

errors.text_span: Die Balken illustrieren den Saldo, beginnend bei ca. -50, variierend zwischen negativen und positiven Werten und endend bei ca. -150.
errors.evidence: The saldo bars are not shown as varying between negative and positive values; they are drawn downward from around 130 on the left scale and become more negative over time, ending around -160 to -170 on the right scale.
The description omits the legend entries and their mapping to the three series (Saldo, Exporte, Importe), which is visible in the figure and highlighted in the reference.
